2566.title: Gnat Pellets
2566.description: A container of questionably produced feed pellets. The label simply reads, "Gnat." The putrid stench of rot and decay emanates from within.

2567.title: Dorter Key
2567.description: A key to the former living quarters of low-ranking Yagudo initiates, converted to a prison after the outbreak of war.

2568.title: Lethe Consomme
2568.description: A light and refreshing vegetable soup that draws on the harmonizing effects of eastern ginger for its aroma and flavor. Standard chocobo fodder.

2569.title: Lethe Potage
2569.description: A thick and hearty vegetable soup that draws on the harmonizing effects of eastern ginger for its aroma and flavor. Standard chocobo fodder.

2604.title: Coin of Advancement
2604.description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a rising sun on the other.

2606.title: Coin of Decay
2606.description: This aged bronze coin bears a peculiar glyph on one side, and the image of a withered leaf on the other.

2609.title: Tinnin's Fang
2609.description: The lethally toxic fang of the hydra, Tinnin. It continues to drip poison from the venom ducts within.

2610.title: Armed Gears' Fragment
2610.description: A mechanical fragment taken from the disassembled remains of the menacing Armed Gears. It appears to be a generator designed for providing large quantities of power.

2611.title: Gotoh Zha's Necklace
2611.description: Neckware of the Mamool Ja, Gotoh Zha the Redolent. Forever imbued with the indelible scent of its owner, it can be equipped by none other.

2612.title: Dea's Horn
2612.description: Taken from the nasal protrusion of the massive wivre Dea, this imposing horn is perfectly adapted for impaling unwary targets.

2613.title: Iriz Ima's Hide
2613.description: The thick, tough hide of Iriz Ima. It's durability is a testament to its capacity to protect the marid against most forms of predation.

2614.title: Amooshah's Tendril
2614.description: A wreathing, vinelike tendril amputated from the malboro Lividroot Amooshah. The meandering of the vine makes it seem to continue to move, even in death.

2615.title: Iriri Samariri's Hat
2615.description: The perfectly form-fit hat of Poroggo Iriri Samariri. Tailor-made to an amphibious head, it cannot and will not adorn the typical adventurer noggin.

2616.title: Vulpangue's Wing
2616.description: A wing clipping taken from the puk, Vulpangue. Its lightness and thinness belie both its strength and durability.

2617.title: Chamrosh's Beak
2617.description: The razor-sharp beak of the colibri Chamrosh, capable of easily tearing apart the flesh of most any creature.

2618.title: Gigiroon's Cape
2618.description: The cape and cowl of Qiqirn, Cheese Hoarder Gigiroon. Fit to the unique form of a Qiqirn body, it cannot be donned by people, and reeks of cheese.

2619.title: Sarameya's Hide
2619.description: The tough, near-impenetrable hide of Sarameya, one of the few known extant members of the cerberus family.

2620.title: Nosferatu's Claw
2620.description: Plunged into its victims and then licked clean of the dripping blood, this clawed appendage of the vampyr Nosferatu still possesses a tangible eeriness.

2621.title: Bhurborlor's Vambrace
2621.description: The solid and well-worn plate armguard once donned by the troll, Khromasoul Bhurborlor. As with all troll armor, it is far too cumbersome to be worn by even the strongest of people.

2622.title: Achamoth's Antenna
2622.description: An antenna taken from the fallen wamoura, Achamoth. This tentacular appendage is adept at detecting even invisible and silent prey.

2623.title: Anantaboga's Heart
2623.description: The enormous heart of the dragon, Anantaboga. It is still saturated through and, through with foul reptilian blood.

2624.title: Reacton's Ashes
2624.description: The smoldering remains of the bomb, Reacton. Despite the passage of time, the cinders retain their immense heat.

2625.title: Dextrose's Blubber
2625.description: The blubberous flesh of the flan, Dextrose. It jiggles incessantly, even when at rest.

2626.title: Brass Borer's Cocoon
2626.description: A cutting taken from the elaborate cocoon spun by the larval wamoura, Brass Borer.

2628.title: Ob's Arm
2628.description: A technologically advanced automaton arm, salvaged from the dismantled remains of Ob.

2629.title: Tyger's Tail
2629.description: Cleaved from the ferocious khimaira, Tyger, this once lethal tail is wielded in both whipping and stabbing motions.

2630.title: Mahjlaef's Staff
2630.description: Too great in power and size to be wielded by people, this wicked staff of the soulflayer Mahjlaef the Paintorn is no doubt responsible for the deaths of countless adventurers.

2631.title: Experimental Lamia's Armband
2631.description: Decorative and protective armware of Experimental Lamia. It inexplicably resists being equipped on the arm of any other.

2632.title: Nuhn's Esca
2632.description: The bioluminescent, bulbous sac of the oboron, Nuhn. The light is used to attract unsuspecting prey in the dark depths of cold waters.

2633.title: Wulgaru's Head
2633.description: The severed head of the acrolith, Wulgaru. It was once animated by a most malicious arcane presence.

2634.title: Zareekhl's Neckpiece
2634.description: Necklace formerly worn by the Qutrub, Zareehkl the Jubilant. It is not suited to dress the neck of any other individual.

2635.title: Verdelet's Wing
2635.description: The detached, fleshy wing of the imp, Verdelet. Either by some latent magic, or simply remaining nerves, it twitches periodically.

2636.title: Velionis's Bone
2636.description: A shard of blackened bone taken from the remains of the wicked skeleton, Velionis.

2637.title: Lil' Apkallu's Egg
2637.description: A shiny egg laid by Lil' Apkallu. The pale green hue of the eggshell is an unmistakable sign.

2640.title: Murex Spicule
2640.description: A peculiar spiny protrusion removed from the curious creature known as a murex

2641.title: Amoeban Pseudopod
2641.description: A mass of some unidentifiable organic substance removed from the curious creature known as an amoeban.

2652.title: Gigas Helm
2652.description: The huge headwear of a full-grown Gigas. Incapable of being equipped by any other race, the helmet is designed as much for inducing fear in the enemy as protecting the head of its wearer.

2653.title: Gigas Gauntlets
2653.description: The massive gauntlets worn by armored Gigas. Far too large or heavy to be worn by people, the lack of skill in craftsmanship is compensated for by sheer enormity and ruggedness.

2654.title: Dark Ixion Horn
2654.description: The twisted and contorted horn wrested from the head of Dark Ixion. It emits an alluring yet lackluster shine of foreboding blackness.

2655.title: Dark Ixion Tail
2655.description: The plush, full tail of Dark Ixion. Despite the ominous aura of evil still surrounding the fine hairs, their innate beauty is undeniable.

2662.description: A Mirage keffiyeh. It is badly damaged and can no longer be worn.

2694.description: A tightly woven basket of bamboo strips used by Yagudo for the safekeeping of valuables. Increases funds.

2701.title: Bamboo Snakecage
2701.description: A tightly woven cage of bamboo strips used by Yagudo for the safekeeping of valuables. Increases prosperity.

2702.title: Buckwheat Flour
2702.description: A relatively dark flour made by grinding the triangular seeds of the buckwheat plant.

2703.title: Khromated Leather
2703.description: A piece of leather made from the hide of a karakul. Khroma has been incorporated into the tanning process, resulting in the distinctive appearance and properties.

2704.title: Oil-Soaked Cloth
2704.description: A swatch of cloth soaked in oil to enhance its resistance to water.

2705.title: Foulard
2705.description: A light fabric made of silk which gives off a beautiful, brilliant sheen.

2706.title: Blue Textile Dye
2706.description: An all-natural, blue dye used in the coloring of cloth.

2707.title: Green Textile Dye
2707.description: An all-natural, green dye used in the coloring of cloth.

2708.title: Yellow Textile Dye
2708.description: An all-natural, yellow dye used in the coloring of cloth.

2709.title: White Textile Dye
2709.description: An all-natural, white dye used in the coloring of cloth.

2710.title: Soba Noodles
2710.description: Thin, round, elongated noodles made from buckwheat flour.

2711.title: Khroma Nugget
2711.description: A small chunk of khroma. Cursory examination reveals that it is not without impurities.

2712.title: Red Textile Dye
2712.description: An all-natural, red dye used in the coloring of cloth.

2713.title: Dyer's Woad
2713.description: A tall-growing grass which blooms marvelous flowers of bright yellow.

2718.title: Etoile Tiara -1
2718.description: An etoile tiara. It is badly damaged and can no longer be worn.

2719.title: Etoile Casaque -1

2725.description: A pair of argute bracers. They are badly damaged and can no longer be worn.

2726.description: A pair of argute pants. They are badly damaged and can no longer be worn.

2727.title: Argute Loafers -1
2727.description: A pair of argute loafers. They are badly damaged and can no longer be worn.

2728.title: Cernunnos Bulb
2728.description: The bulb of a mobile plant known as the Cernunnos. Though currently in stasis, it can grow with the proper nutrients.

2729.title: Hydrangea
2729.description: An exotic flower that grows only in the Far East, with leafy petals that change hue from deep blue to a rich reddish-violet.

2733.title: Spirit Smilodon Leather
2733.description: Enhanced by the power of anima, the toughness of this piece of smilodon leather is unworldly.

2735.title: Dark Ixion Ferrule
2735.description: A ferrule fashioned from the gnarled horn of Dark Ixion. Long after being separated from its master, it continues to pulse and throb with an otherworldly energy.

2737.title: Silky Suede
2737.description: The tough hide of a buffalo has been meticulously napped to create this silky-smooth fabric.

2740.title: Seedspall Lux
2740.description: A shard of the Seed Crystal recovered from Jugner Forest. It blazes with the blinding radiance of a white-hot sun.

2741.title: Seedspall Luna
2741.description: A shard of the Seed Crystal recovered from the Pashhow Marshlands. It shines with the soft luminescence of an autumn moon.

2742.title: Seedspall Astrum
2742.description: A shard of the Seed Crystal recovered from the Meriphataud Mountains. It twinkles with the glittering splendor of a sea of stars.

2743.title: Oxblood Orb
2743.description: An exquisite orb fashioned from the extrememly rare variety of blood-red coral known as oxblood.

2744.title: Angel Skin Orb
2744.description: An exquisite orb fashioned from the extremely rare variety of pinkish coral known as angel skin.

2747.title: Gargouille Horn
2747.description: A Gargouille's horn, its edge as sharp as tempered steel.

2748.title: Gargouille Shank
2748.description: A shank of gargouille flesh, hardened by time into something resembling solid rock.

2749.title: Gargouille Eye
2749.description: The lustrous, crystalline eye of a gargouille.

2750.title: Amphiptere Hide
2750.description: The glossy, scaly hide of an amphiptere.

2751.title: Amphiptere Leather
2751.description: The rough hide of an amphiptere has been processed into a smooth and sturdy square of leather.

2752.title: Amphiptere Whisker
2752.description: The bristly, whip-like whisker of an amphiptere.

2753.title: Amphiptere Claw
2753.description: This razor-sharp claw is still specked with the blood of the amphiptere's unfortunate prey.

2754.title: Ruszor Fang
2754.description: The massive fang of a ruszor, sharp enough to slice through blocks of solid ice.

2755.title: Ruszor Hide
2755.description: The ruszor's hide is surprisingly soft and silky to the touch.

2756.title: Ruszor Leather
2756.description: This sturdy leather made from the hide of a ruszor is particularly resistant to frigid temperatures.

2757.title: Orcish Armor Plate
2757.description: A metal plate that appears to have fallen off of an Orcish Warmachine.

2758.title: Quadav Backscale
2758.description: A bronze scale donned as added back protection by Quadav warriors.

2759.title: Yagudo Caulk
2759.description: A traditional adhesive and filling material invented by the Yagudo.

2761.title: Feyweald Log
2761.description: A rough-cut log from a tree of the Feyweald, the pixie forest of legend.

2762.title: Feyweald Lumber
2762.description: Processed lumber from a tree of the Feyweald, the pixie forest of legend.

2763.title: Swamp Ore
2763.description: This slimy ore, found often in marshlands, contains the metal iron.

2764.title: Dweomer Steel
2764.description: Smelted by fey magic, this steel ingot is warm to touch.

2765.title: Fool's Gold Ore
2765.description: This ore contains bronze, iron, and sulfur. Its luster pales in comparison to genuine gold.

2767.title: Oberon's Gold
2767.description: An ingot of the purest gold, smelted by the fey magic of Oberon, King of Faeries.

2769.title: Buggane Horn
2769.description: The pitch-black horn of a buggane, a fearsome ogre summoned by pixies to exact revenge on invaders who threatened their forest home. It glows with an eerie energy.

2770.title: White Butterfly
2770.description: A magnificent white butterfly with gossamer wings that glisten in the sunlight.

2771.title: Bell Cricket
2771.description: A colorful species of jumping bug known for its peaceful chirping song.

2772.title: Glowfly
2772.description: A small, jet-black insect of the beetle family that emits an ethereal yellowish glow from its abdomen.

2773.title: Fine Parchment
2773.notes: Fine Parchment Scribes the world over swear by this fine quality sheepskin parchment for the hours of smudge-free writing pleasure it offers. Stackable: Not Stackable

2774.title: Enchanted Ink
2774.description: Literally fill your words with magic with this rare variety of enchanted ink.

2775.title: Padded Box
2775.description: An empty box lined with shock-absorbent material, designed for the transportation of fragile objects. Includes wrapping paper.

2776.title: Pumice Stone
2776.description: This pumice stone is used to rub away the layer of sheen from animal hide.

2777.title: Magicked Blood
2777.description: The dark magic infused within this portion of blood causes it to swish about fitfully within its vial.

2778.title: Inferior Cocoon
2778.description: A low-grade cocoon of unknown origin, unsuitable for commercial use.

2779.title: Enfeeblement Kit: Poison
2779.description:
The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto. It contains four jars of ink, one sheet of parchment, 
and one essence of poison.

2780.title: Enfeeblement Kit: Blind
2780.description:
The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto. It contains three jars of ink, two sheets of parchment, 
and one essence of blindness.

2781.title: Enfeeblement Kit: Sleep
2781.description:
The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto. It contains two jars of ink, three sheets of parchment, 
and one essence of sleep.

2782.title: Enfeeblement Kit: Silence
2782.description:
The enfeeblement kit requested by Doctor Shantotto. It contains one jar of ink, four sheets of parchment, 
and one essence of silence.

2784.title: Fire Fewell
2784.description: A synergy staple, this substance yields potent elemental power when burned.

fields.notes: Restores 50 Fire Fewell when traded to a furnace you have claim over.

2792.title: Catalytic Oil
2792.description: Developed by the Bastokan Alchemists' Guild, this oil can be added to various substances to facilitate combustion.

2808.title: Ebon Pigment
2808.description: A powerful colorant used by synergists to infuse materials with rich ebony tones.

2809.title: Furia Pigment
2809.description: A powerful colorant used by synergists to infuse materials with fiery red hues.

2810.title: Ebur Pigment
2810.description: A powerful colorant used by synergists to infuse materials with the pure white of ivory.

2811.title: Aptant: Primus
2811.description: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "source."

2813.title: Aptant: Durus
2813.description: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "durable."

2822.title: Aptant: Secan
2822.description: A burnished metallic token bearing an ancient glyph for "attack."

2823.title: Iridium Ingot
2823.description: A rare precious metal that is exceptionally durable and heat-resistant.

2824.title: Shagreen
2824.description: Unusually durable leather of indeterminate animal origin. Curious bumps dot the surface.

2825.title: Cambric
2825.description: An elegant woven fabric that sparkles brilliantly under light.

2826.title: Mandragora Scale
2826.description: A charming brass scale in the shape of a mandragora's leaf crown.

2827.title: Rugged Gold Thread
2827.description: This gold thread is sturdy enough to support the weight of even the burliest bugbear.

2828.title: Herensugue Skin
2828.description: The supple yet resilient skin of Herensugue.

2829.title: Radiant Velvet
2829.description: This square of velvet is so brilliantly colored as to seem to radiate light.

2830.title: Bastet Fang
2830.description: The saber-like caspid of Bastet, sharp enough to pierce even the toughest- skinned prey

2831.title: Yellow Brass Chain
2831.description: Of higher purity than ordinary brass, this chain shines a brilliant yellow.

2832.title: Samwell's Shank
2832.description: The giant leg bone of Slumbering Samwell. If only he could have stayed awake, it may still be attached to his body.

2833.title: Thunder Coral
2833.description: A piece of coral with sharp, jagged branches that resemble bolts of lightning.

2834.title: Immortal Molt
2834.description: The molt of a highlander lizard, shed in a climactic battle with another of its kind. There can be only one!

2835.title: Dahu Hair
2835.description: Hair from the mane of a dahu. No matter how hard you try to straighten it, it always reverts to a twisted, gnarled state.

2836.title: Woolly Pelage
2836.description: A pelage from a giant ram so thick and fluffy it could keep an adventurer warm on even the coldest nights.

2837.title: Ratatoskr Pelt
2837.description: The pelt of the elusive Ratatoskr, sought after by many a hunter.

2838.title: Ephemeral Cloth
2838.description: A piece of cloth so delicate and thin it seems about to fade from existence at any moment.

2839.title: Coquecigrue Skin
2839.description: The absurdly grotesque skin of the fabled coquecigrue..

2840.title: Imperial Topaz
2840.description: A resplendent yellow topaz of peerless cut and clarity.

2841.title: Quadav Silver Ingot
2841.description: An ingot of silver refined using Quadav smelting techniques.

2842.title: Flawed Garnet
2842.description: A garnet so murky and rough that it resembles little more then a misshapen lump of red stone.

2843.title: Lineadach
2843.description: A particularly elegant square of linen woven by a Fomor.

2844.title: Penumbral Brass
2844.description: An ingot of brass with oddly patterned streaks of black that appear to shift like shadows.

2845.title: Aramid Fiber
2845.description: An unnatural-seeming fiber that is curiously resilient given its thin and supple nature.

2846.title: Hefty Oak Lumber
2846.description: An exceptionally heavy and sturdy- looking piece of oak lumber.

2847.title: Blue Jasper
2847.description: A jasper of brilliant blue, so rarely seen that many consider it but a myth.

2848.title: Grimy Bronze Sheet
2848.description: This bronze sheet is so filthy with dirt and grime that it turns the stomach even to touch it.

2849.title: Likho Talon
2849.description: The sharp, dagger-like talon of a likho.

2850.title: Sahagin Gold
2850.description: An ingot smelted from the alluvial gold retrieved by the Sahagin from an ancient river bed.

2851.title: Bukktooth
2851.description: The massive and sturdy molar of a rambukk, worn down from chewing large quantities of cud.

2852.title: Tenebrium
2852.description: A shadowy black ingot smelted by demons in their netherworldly forge.

2853.title: Malebolge Mandrel
2853.description: A hellishly warped mandrel said to have the power to twist its possessor's soul.

2854.title: Stately Crab Shell
2854.description: This massive shell from a rare species of land crab is so hard it feels like metal to the touch.

2855.title: Mahogany Heartwood
2855.description: The darkest and hardest wood from the center of an ancient mahogany tree.

2856.title: Ensanguined Cloth
2856.description: A bloodstained cloth that belonged to a ghost.

2859.title: Cobalt Ore
2859.description: Ore containing the lustrous metal cobalt. When processed with other metals, it produces a brilliant blue hue.

2861.title: Timeworn Talisman
2861.description: The years have not been kind to this Ephramadian tailsman. An image of the Dark Rider embossed on its surface is barely distinguishable.

2874.title: Lambent Scale
2874.description: This delicate scale from the wing of a pixie glows with a soothing light. It is said to have curative powers.

2875.title: Ethereal Squama
2875.description: A delicate scale from the wing of a pixie, so thin and tenuous as to be almost imperceptible.

2876.title: Muculent Ingot
2876.description: This ingot of pure gold is coated in a viscous, slimy substance that clings tenaciously to its surface.

2877.title: Befouled Silver
2877.description: Years spent in the possession of baleful monsters have lent an ill- boding glint to this once-pure precious metal.

2878.title: Scarlet Kadife
2878.description: Luxurious and smooth to the touch, this fabric is such a deep red as to make one wonder if it were dyed with blood.

2879.title: Igneous Barnacle
2879.description: Jagged to the touch, this barnacle from the shell of the massive Krabkatoa is coated with a layer of hardened magma.

2880.title: Kidney Stone
2880.description: A tawny crystalline stone recovered from the body of the antlion Orcus, quite beautiful despite its unpleasant origin.

2882.title: Baby Blobdingnag
2882.description: A smallish globule of red slime split off from Blobdingnag. If left alone, will it grow to the size of its parent...?

2883.title: Ruthven's Nail
2883.description: The dagger-like fingernail of the fearsome vampyr Lord Ruthven, still specked with the blood of one of his unfortunate victims.

2884.title: Krabkatoa Shell
2884.description: The massive, still-smoldering shell of the gargantuan Krabkatoa, as solid and durable as a slab of volcanic rock.

2885.title: Orcus Mandible
2885.description: The imposing mandible of the mammoth antlion Orcus, suited to instantaneously crushing the life out of unwitting prey.

2888.title: Sanguinet
2888.description: A translucent mass of tissue found protruding from the body of certain vorageans. Though slightly cracked, it retains a vivid scarlet hue.

2889.title: Limule Pincer
2889.description: The spiny pincer of a limule.

2890.title: Clionid Wing
2890.description: The delicate, translucent wing of a clionid.

2891.title: Dried Chigoe
2891.description: The withered husk of a dead chigoe.

2892.title: Raw Mutton Chop
2892.description: This bloody slab of ram meat exudes an overpowering raw odor.

2893.title: Gargantuan Black Tiger Fang
2893.description: The oversized fang of a gargantuan species of black tiger.

2894.title: Trophy Shield
2894.description: A shield claimed by a Gigas off the body of a particularly renowned adventurer it slew.

2895.title: Oversized Sock
2895.description: This oversized sock of a Gigas reeks of blood and sweat. Far too large (and rancid) to be worn except by Gigas.

2896.title: Massive Armband
2896.description: A weighted armband used by Gigas in building their hulking muscles. Far too heavy to be worn except by Gigas.

2897.title: Transparent Insect Wing
2897.description: An insect wing so transparent as to be almost invisible to the eye.

2898.title: Piceous Scale
2898.description: A pitch-black scale that seems to smother the light around it.

2899.title: Winter Puk Egg
2899.description: Puk eggs laid in winter, such as this one, are said to be particularly rich in nutrients.

2900.title: Bug-eaten Hat
2900.description: This hole-ridden hat of a Poroggo appears to have provided a meal for many an insect. Only Poroggos can equip it.

2901.title: Giant Agaricus
2901.description: A particularly large and earthy agaricus mushroom.

2902.title: Filthy Gnole Claw
2902.description: This massive gnole claw is caked with dirt and grime.

2903.title: Eft Blood
2903.description: Blood from an eft, said to be so vile that even leeches steer clear of it.

2904.title: Giant Slug Eyestalk
2904.description: The long, slimy eyestalk of a giant slug.

2905.title: Moonglow Cloth
2905.description: A gossamer astral fabric that glows only under the light of the moon. Far too delicate to use in crafting.

2906.title: Rotting Eyeball
2906.description: An eyeball from a treant that has begun to decompose

2908.title: Oblivispore
2908.description: A poisonous fungus said to wipe clean the memory of any who eats it. Not suitable for consumption.

2909.title: Snakeskin Moss
2909.description: A curious mottled moss that had been growing from the back of a goobbue.

2910.title: Armored Dragonhorn
2910.description: The massive horn of a wivre, of fearsome size and sharpness.

2911.title: Ripped Eft Skin
2911.description: A skin that appears to have been savagely ripped from the body of the eft it once belonged to.

2912.title: Giant Bugard Tusk
2912.description: The particularly gargantuan tusk of a bugard.

2913.title: Clouded Lens
2913.description: A murky lens from the eye of an Ahriman.

2917.title: Bloodshot Hecteye
2917.description: The bloodshot eyeball of a hecteyes.

2918.title: Baleful Skull
2918.description: The cursed skull of a corpselight.

2919.title: Bloody Fang
2919.description: The fang of a bat, flecked with fresh blood.

2920.title: Alkaline Humus
2920.description: The strong alkaline concentration of this humus renders it highly unsuitable for gardening.

2921.title: Venomous Scorpion Stinger
2921.description: Still dripping with potent venom, this scorpion stinger must be handled with care.

2922.title: Eft Egg
2922.description: In spite of (or perhaps because of?) the slight sulphurous odor it exudes, eft eggs such as this one are considered a delicacy.

2923.title: Cockatrice Tailmeat
2923.description: Meat from the tail of a cockatrice. Stringy and flavorless, it is quite unpopular among culinarians.

2924.title: Shocking Whisker
2924.description: This whisker cut from the face of a coeurl pulsates with energy in your hand.

2925.title: Resilient Mane
2925.description: A particularly pliant and durable manticore mane.

2926.title: Moaning Vestige
2926.description: A fragment of some unidentifiable organic substance that emits a faint moaning sound.

2927.title: Glavoid Shell
2927.description: The massive shell of a glavoid.

2928.title: Two-Leaf Chloris Bud
2928.description: An oversized flower from the crown of a chloris.

2930.title: Carabosse's Gem
2930.description: A small yet tasteful gem that belonged to the evil pixie queen Carabosse.

2931.title: Fistule Discharge
2931.description: A thick, foul-smelling liquid expelled from a fistule.

2932.title: Kukulkan's Fang
2932.description: The massive fang of Kukulkan, capable of impaling a knight clean through his armor.

2933.title: Chukwa's Egg
2933.description: Laid by Chukwa, this egg is several orders of magnitude larger than a typical adamantoise egg.

2934.title: Manananggal's Necklet
2934.description: The oversized necklet of a manananggal. An incantation of warding prevents any but its original owner from equipping it.

2935.title: Marvin's Pelage
2935.description: The ratty, flea-ridden pelage of Mangy-tailed Marvin.

2936.title: Chasmic Stinger
2936.description: A dagger-like stinger harvested from the body of a chasmic hornet.

2937.title: Raskovnik Vine
2937.description: The giant vine of a raskovnik.

2938.title: Bakka's Wing
2938.description: A wing clipped from the imp lord Bakka.

2939.title: Cuelebre's Horn
2939.description: The fearsome horn of the legendary serpent Cuelebre.

2940.title: Mictlantecuhtli's Habit
2940.description: The dark robes worn by the necromancer Mictlantecuhtli while performing his dark rituals. Not wearable by living beings.

2941.title: Keesha Pamama
2941.description: A pamama purloined from the possession of the fruit-fancying Keesha Poppo.

2942.title: Mikey's Nugget
2942.description: A hefty silver nugget removed from the stomach of Megamaw Mikey. Likely the cause of a mega-serious case of indigestion.

2943.title: Balaur Skull
2943.description: The ghastly skull of a balaur wyvern.

2944.title: Lieje Lantern
2944.description: Once carried by a Tonberry Lieje, this lantern still burns with an ominous, hateful light.

2945.title: Shriveled Wing
2945.description: The wing of a clionid, now shriveled from excess exposure to the air.

2946.title: Tarnished Pincer
2946.description: The pincer of a limule, now tarnished from excess exposure to the air.

2947.title: Exorcised Skull
2947.description: This corpselight skull has been cleansed of the curse that once resided in it

2948.title: Acidic Humus
2948.description: Mildly acidic in composition, this humus is well suited for gardening.

2949.title: Quivering Eft Egg
2949.description: This eft egg seems about to hatch at any moment...

2950.title: Smooth Whisker
2950.description: Drained of electricity, this coeurl whisker is soft and smooth to the touch.

2951.title: Malachite
2951.description: This spectacular green-colored mineral shimmers brilliantly even in dim light.

2953.title: Viscous Spittle
2953.description: A slimy substance expectorated by a rare species of arachnid. Can be used as an adhesive.

2954.title: Powder Casket
2954.description: A small casket of gunpowder. Dampened from time spent underwater, it is likely unusable in its current state.

fields.notes: Many Powder Caskets are duds, and will be rejected by the quest NPC for Dropping the Bomb. If this happens, you must obtain another.

2960.title: Water Lily
2960.description: The delicate, light purple blossom of a water lily.

2961.title: Sanguine Spike
2961.description: The fearsome spike of a peiste, dripping with both venom and the blood of the creature's prey.

2962.title: Itzpapalotl's Scale
2962.description: A glossy black scale resembling obsidian, harvested from the wing of Itzpapalotl.

2963.title: Ulhuadshi's Fang
2963.description: A massive fang extracted from the mouth of the giant sandworm Ulhuadshi.

2964.title: Sobek's Skin
2964.description: The skin of the gargantuan bugard Sobek, as rugged as the face of a mountain.

2965.title: Cirein-croin's Lantern
2965.description: The eerie light stalk of Cirein-croin, employed by this fearsome deep sea hunter to lure prey of all sizes.

2966.title: Bukhis's Wing
2966.description: The massive wing of the gargantuan taurus known as Bukhis.

2967.title: Sedna's Tusk
2967.description: The overgrown tusk of the ruszor Sedna, so sharp and sturdy that it can cut through glaciers.

2975.title: Manigordo Tusk
2975.description: The keen-edged, oversized cuspid of a manigordo.

2976.title: Badlands Salt
2976.description: A flavorful salt found in the shell of a desert-dwelling crab.

2977.title: Punch Bug
2977.description: A rare and remarkable insect that, despite its minuscule size, is capable of boring holes in the hardest rocks and shells.

3072.title: Withered Cocoon
3072.description: The withered cocoon of a wamoura.

3073.title: Eruca Egg
3073.description: The oversized egg of an eruca.

3074.title: Blanched Silver
3074.description: A small lump of silver that has lost some of its lustre.

3075.title: Undying Ooze
3075.description: This repulsive gunk continues to bubble and squirm long after being separated from the doomed that excreted it.

3076.title: Bone Chips
3076.description: Cracked and chipped bones of various size, shape and origin.

3077.title: Wailing Rags
3077.description: When you rest your ear on these tattered garments, you can hear a tortured scream in the distance.

3078.title: Cracked Dragonscale
3078.description: A massive force must have been required to cause this sturdy scale of a dragon to crack.

3079.title: Gory Pincer
3079.description: This scorpion pincer is caked with the blood of its prey.

3080.title: Extended Eyestalk
3080.description: The fully extended eyestalk of a slug, doomed never to return to its retracted state.

3081.title: Coeurl Round
3081.description: This round cut of thigh meat from a coeurl is laced with fat and gristle.

3082.title: Withered Bud
3082.description: Separated from the mandragora it sprouted from, it looks about to crumble into dust at any moment.

3083.title: Mangled Cockatrice Skin
3083.description: The cockatrice this skin was taken from clearly did not go down without a fight...

3084.title: Great Root
3084.description: The thick root of an ancient treant.

3085.title: Bewitching Tusk
3085.description: The ensorcelled tusk of a bugard.

3086.title: Molt Scraps
3086.description: Scraps from the shedded molt of a lizard.

3087.title: Apkallu Down
3087.description: These underfeathers of an apkallu are soft and warm to the touch.

3088.title: Avian Remex
3088.description: A large feather that allows birds to control their flight path in strong wind.

3089.title: Orobon Cheekmeat
3089.description: The rare cheekmeat of an orobon, considered a delicacy.

3090.title: Spheroid Plate
3090.description: A plate of some indeterminate metal, retrieved from a deactivated spheroid.

3091.title: Hardened Raptor Skin
3091.description: The frozen, hardened skin of a raptor.

3092.title: Mocking Beak
3092.description: The beak of a colibri said to have the ability to mimic adventurers' voices.

3093.title: High-Quality Crab Meat
3093.description: This piece of land crab meat is of perfect quality. So perfect, in fact, that it would be unthinkable to eat it.

3094.title: High-Quality Rock Salt
3094.description: A chunk of rock salt of the highest grade and quality.

3095.title: Worm-Eaten Bud
3095.description: This hole-ridden mandragora bud has clearly served as a feast for many a famished worm.

3096.title: Spotted Flyfrond
3096.description: An attractive spotted pattern adorns this giant flytrap leaf.

3097.title: Black Rabbit Tail
3097.description: The tail of a rabbit, said to serve as a warding talisman.

3098.title: Gnarled Taurus Horn
3098.description: The balefully gnarled horn of a taurus.

3099.title: Gargouille Stone
3099.description: A hunk of flesh from the gargouille that has hardened to the point that it is indistinguishable from actual stone.

3100.title: Moonbeam Clam
3100.description: A rare clam said to open its shell only when the light of the moon shines upon it.

3101.title: Dented Skull
3101.description: The skull of a corpselight that seems to have caught a hefty blow to its head.

3102.title: Stiffened Tentacle
3102.description: This tentacle has stiffened after the death of the soulflayer it was once attached to.

3103.title: Black Whisker
3103.description: Other than its jet-black color, this feline whisker is entirely unremarkable.

3104.title: Opaque Wing
3104.description: The murky-colored wing of some unnatural beast.

3105.title: Fortune Wing
3105.description: This red wing of a ladybug is said to bring good luck to he who finds it.

3106.title: Djinn Ashes
3106.description: The smoldering ashes of a now- extinguished djinn.

3107.title: Shockshroom
3107.description: A poisonous mushrom said to send a paralyzing shock through the body if consumed.

3108.title: Crawler Floatstone
3108.description: A small stone removed from the stomach of a crawler. Can be used as pumice.

3109.title: High-Quality Rabbit Hide
3109.description: The particularly sturdy hide of a rabbit.

3230.title: Tablilla Mercury
3230.description: A shimmering liquid metal extracted from the doll Tablilla.

3231.title: Sharabha Hide
3231.description: The rugged hide of the manticore Sharabha.

3232.title: Tiger King Hide
3232.description: The regally colored hide of the fell tiger Ansherekh.

3233.title: Vadleany Fluid
3233.description: A pungent liquid extracted from a slain vadleany, its role of driving away would-be foes unfulfilled.

3234.title: Oasis Water
3234.description: A precious bottle of pure water from a desert oasis, carried by the fearsome Bugul Noz.

3235.title: Sandy Shard
3235.description: Desert sand clings to the surface of this shattered doll fragment.

3236.title: Smoldering Arm
3236.description: This arm of a bomb still steams and smolders despite having been long since severed from its master.

3239.title: Puppet's Blood
3239.description: The blood of an unnaturally bred puk, said to impel anyone who drinks it to dance uncontrollably.

3241.title: Ladybird Leaf
3241.description: A broad, thick-veined leaf that had been stuck to the back of an unaware ladybug.

3243.title: Sabulous Clay
3243.description: A variety of desert clay with a high sand content.

3244.title: Giant Mistletoe
3244.description: A parasitic plant so tenacious that it is known to strangle the life out of even the mightiest oaks.

3245.title: Bevel Gear
3245.description: A massive, jagged-tooth gear of bronze that powered the mighty Koghatu.

3246.title: Snow God Core
3246.description: This condensed soul of the fearsome Upas-Kamuy burns with a chill blue flame.

3247.title: Sisyphus Fragment
3247.description: A fragment of debris claimed off the shattered body of the golem Sisyphus.

3248.title: Rimed Wing
3248.description: The frost-covered wing of the notorious imp Chillwing Hwitti.

3249.title: Audumbla Hide
3249.description: The rough hide of the bovine audumbla.

3250.title: Helical Gear
3250.description: A curved metallic gear that once powered a mighty acrolith.

3251.title: Gear Fluid
3251.description: A peculiar, oil-like substance that will not freeze in even the coldest temperatures.

3252.title: Gelid Arm
3252.description: The arm of a snoll, so stingingly cold that holding it in one's bare hand will inflict an almost instant case of frostbite.

3254.title: Ice Wyvern Scale
3254.description: This wyvern scale is as chill as ice to the touch.

3255.title: Whiteworm Clay
3255.description: A rich clay-like substance excreted from the body of an entozoon.

3256.title: Imp Sentry's Horn
3256.description: A compact horn employed by imp sentries to warn their masters of potential interlopers.

3257.title: Benumbed Eye
3257.description: This clouded eye of a benumbed vodoriga stares at you with a soulless, empty gaze.

3258.title: High-Quality Buffalo Horn
3258.description: A particularly large and sturdy buffalo horn.

3259.title: High-Quality Black Tiger Hide
3259.description: The particularly rugged and sleek hide of a black tiger.

3260.title: Teekesselchen Fragment
3260.description: The shattered fragment of the Teekesselchen.

3261.title: Minaruja Skull
3261.description: The abnormally hard skull of the wyvern Minaruja.

3262.title: Jaculus Wing
3262.description: The almost-weightless yet highly durable wing of the peapuk Jaculus.

3263.title: Naiad's Lock
3263.description: A wispy lock of hair from the pixie Lorelei, whose haunting song is said to have beckoned many an adventurer to an untimely demise.

3264.title: Goblin Gunpowder
3264.description: A highly explosive gunpowder devised by the mad Goblin bombardier Burstrox Powderpate.

3265.title: Bubbling Oil
3265.description: Extracted from a magic pot, the noxious fumes of this thick oil induce nausea with a single whiff

3266.title: Darkflame Arm
3266.description: Severed from an unfortunate djinn, this arm blazes with a black, heatless flame.

3267.title: Pursuer's Wing
3267.description: The wing of the ajattara wyvern, said to chase away evil spirits of the forest.

3268.title: High-Quality Wivre Hide
3268.description: The particularly thick and durable skin of a wivre.

3269.title: Decaying Molar
3269.description: Eaten away from within by hungry grubs, this molar of a skeleton smells even worse than it looks.

3270.title: High-Quality Pugil Scale
3270.description: This large pugil scale shimmers brilliantly under light.

3271.title: Fay Teardrop
3271.description: A teardrop-shaped clear gemstone claimed from a slain pixie.

3272.title: Unseelie Eye
3272.description: A dark jewel claimed from a slain unseelie.

3273.title: Goblin Rope
3273.description: An unsightly but sturdy rope of Goblin make.

3274.title: Goblin Oil
3274.description: This malodorous oil is employed by Goblins to prevent their armor from rusting any more than it already has.

3287.title: Orthrus's Claw
3287.description: The claw of Orthrus, long-lost brother of Cerberus, has carried many a would-be hero to the beast's dreadful maw.

3288.title: Dragua's Scale
3288.description: A scale from the wyrm Dragua, said to be as impenetrable as the hardest metal.

3289.title: Apademak's Horn
3289.description: The massive, gnarled horn of the warbringer Apademak inspires fear and awe.

3290.title: Isgebind's Heart
3290.description: The frozen heart of the dragon Isgebind, as cold to the touch as chill fetters of ice.

3291.title: Alfard's Fang
3291.description: The massive fang of Alfard drips with lethal poison.

3292.title: Azdaja's Horn
3292.description: The horrifically twisted horn of Azdaja, embodiment of hatred and destruction.

3293.title: Iron Plate
3293.description: A piece wrenched from the plate armor of an iron giant.

3294.title: Colorless Soul
3294.description: This elemental soul, drained of all its power, has faded to a milky white.

3315.title: Ominous Skull
3315.description: Oddly well preserved, the hollow eyes of this skull gaze at you with a baleful expression.

3339.title: Honey Wine
3339.description: A known favorite of the notorious Fafnir. Allegedly irresistible enough to draw the legendary wyrm out of hiding.

3340.title: Sweet Tea
3340.description: A known favorite of the notorious Nidhogg. Allegedly irresistible enough to draw the malevolent wyrm out of hiding.

3341.title: Beastly Shank
3341.description: A known favorite of the notorious Behemoth. Allegedly irresistible enough to draw the hulking monstrosity out of hiding.

3342.title: Savory Shank
3342.description: A known favorite of the notorious King Behemoth. Allegedly irresistible enough to draw the monarch of monstrosities out of hiding.

3343.title: Blue Pondweed
3343.description: A known favorite of the notorious Adamantoise. Allegedly irresistible enough to draw the towering turtle out of hiding.

3344.title: Red Pondweed
3344.description: A known favorite of the notorious Aspidochelone. Allegedly irresistible enough to draw the titanic tortoise out of hiding.

3353.title: Barbaric Bijou
3353.description: A small gem used as a means of communication among fiends. Typically colorless, it is said to take on myriad hues when used.

3354.title: Steelwall Bijou
3354.description: A small gem used as a means of communication among fiends. Typically colorless, it is said to take on myriad hues when used.

3355.title: Divine Bijou
3355.description: A small gem used as a means of communication among fiends. Typicall colorless, it is said to take on myriad hues when used.

3356.title: Roving Bijou
3356.description: A small gem used as a means of communication among fiends. Typically colorless, it is said to take on myriad hues when used.

3357.title: Leering Bijou
3357.description: A small gem used as a means of communication among fiends. Typicall colorless, it is said to take on myriad hues when used.

3358.title: Shrouded Bijou
3358.description: A small gem used as a means of communication among fiends. Typically colorless, it is said to take on myriad hues when used.

3364.title: Mystic Goad
3364.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden pair of knuckles.

3365.title: Ornate Goad
3365.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden dagger.

3366.title: Holy Goad
3366.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden longsword.

3367.title: Intricate Goad
3367.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden claymore.

3368.title: Runaeic Goad
3368.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden tabar.

3369.title: Seraphic Goad
3369.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden great axe.

3370.title: Tenebrous Goad
3370.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden scythe.

3371.title: Stellar Goad
3371.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden spear.

3372.title: Demoniac Goad
3372.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden kunai.

3373.title: Divine Goad
3373.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden tachi.

3374.title: Heavenly Goad
3374.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden hammer.

3375.title: Celestial Goad
3375.description: An ancient coin embossed with the likeness of a forbidden staff.

3376.title: Snarled Goad

4629.title: Holy
4629.description: Teaches the white magic Holy. Deals light elemental damage to an enemy.

fields.notes:

Has a shorter cast range than Banish.

4632.title: Dia II
4632.description: Teaches the white magic Dia II. Lowers an enemy's defense and gradually deals light elemental damage.

fields.notes:
Deals 4 damage initially, then ticks 2 damage every 3 seconds for the duration of the spell.

The initial damage can be increased with enough Magic Attack Bonus, Weather and Elemental Affinity boosts. Equipment with Enhances "Dia" effect such as Dia Wand increases the damage over time component of the spell by 1.

The Defense Down value is a flat 15%, increased to 18% with the effects of a Corsair's Light Shot. Higher Tier Dia spells will overwrite this effect. Box Step's Sluggish Daze, Geomancy's Frailty effects will stack with this effect. Other sources of Defense Down such as that from Acid Bolts and Armor Break may also be active on a target, but these sources are mutually exclusive with each other.

Dia's Defense Down effect cannot be resisted except in cases of complete spell immunity (e.g. Magic Shield).

Dia's effects are overwritten by equal or higher-tier Bio spell effects. Dia will only overwrite lower-tier Bio spell effects. Dia and Bio may not be on the same enemy target at the same time.

Automatons will cast this spell with every Head configuration except Valoredge Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4636.title: Banish
4636.description: Teaches the white magic Banish. Deals light elemental damage to an enemy.

fields.notes:
Accuracy influenced by Divine Magic Skill and Magic Accuracy bonuses from equipment.
*Damage resist rates depend on the difference in MND between the caster and target.
*Receives bonus damage multipliers from Afflatus Misery and Divine Emblem.
**Casting Banish while Afflatus Misery is activated grants a potency bonus to the spell based on the most recent damage you have sustained. The record of damage taken is reset upon use.
**While under the effect of Divine Emblem, a bonus is granted to the damage of Banish based on the player's Divine Magic Skill

Banish does 50% additional damage to undead foes and partially negates specific damage taken resistance from certain undead mob species. The amount cut is applied multiplicatively by a set term. The duration of this additional effect vs. Undead monsters is subject to partial resist rates. The resist rates to the Banish spell damage and specific damage taken cut components of Banish spells are calculated separately. 
*The specific damage taken reduction term for Banish is 50%. For example, a Skeleton-type foe has a natural 50% Piercing damage resistance. Under the effects of Banish, they will have 0.5 x 0.5 = 0.25, or 25% Piercing damage taken resistance.
*Higher tier Banish spells inflict a higher specific damage taken effect vs. Undead targets. Higher-tier Banish spells will overwrite the effects of lower-tier Banish spells.
*Equipment with "Effect of "Banish" against undead +" attributes increase the potency of the specific damage taken effect.

The Group 1 White Mage Merit Ability "Banish Effect" adds +2 Magic Attack Bonus and extends the duration of the specific damate taken effect by 2 seconds per merit level.

fields.notes:
Stoneskin absorbs a set amount of damage before wearing off. Stoneskin's total bank of damage absorption is a function of the caster's MND and Enhancing Magic Skill. The formula varies on an inflection point calculated by:



If BASE < 80, then the damage absorption is equal to the BASE value.
If 80 ≤ BASE < 130 then: 


If 130 ≤ BASE then:

fields.notes:

4664.title: Slow
4664.description: Teaches the white magic Slow. Reduces an enemy's attack speed.

fields.notes:
The potency of the attack speed reduction is a function of the difference between caster and target MND. Two derived forumulae govern this:

If caster MND ≥ target MND
*Attack speed reduction = 14.88% + ((Caster MND - Target MND) * 0.2)
If caster MND < target MND
*Attack speed reduction = 14.88% + ((Caster MND - Target MND) * 0.1)

The lowest potency is 7.3%, the maximum potency (at ΔMND ≥ 75) is 29.2% 

Partial resists of this spell halve the duration.

Automatons will cast this spell under every Head configuration except Valoredge Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4665.title: Haste
4665.description: Teaches the white magic Haste. Increases target's attack speed.

fields.notes:

Duration decreases when cast on players below level 40.

Does not stack with and is overwritten by Flurry. Will overwrite Flurry effects.

Accession does not confer its benefits to this spell.

Automatons only cast this spell when equipped with Stormwaker Head or Soulsoother Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

See Haste (Status Effect) for the limits and mechanics of total attack speed delay.

4687.title: Recall-Jugner
4687.description: Teaches the white magic Recall-Jugner. Transports qualified party members within area of effect to Jugner Forest (S).

fields.notes:
The spell only functions on characters with the Wings of the Goddess expansion and the Jugner gate crystal. The key item can be obtained by examining the Telepoint located at the border of G-9/H-9 in Jugner Forest (S). The telepoint does not exist in the present day version of the zone.

If the caster does not meet the requirements, they are still able to teleport any of their nearby qualified party members, but the caster will be left where they are.

If the caster has the key item but does not wish to be teleported, they may avoid being teleported by starting to cast the spell and immediately running into the next zone when the cast reaches 70-80%. The caster will end up in the neighboring zone but any nearby party members will still be teleported to the intended destination. It is also possible to avoid teleportation by having a Nomad Moogle change your job when the cast reaches 70-80%.

4701.title: Cura
4701.description: Teaches the white magic Cura Restores HP for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
10' effective area radius.

The base heal value is 30.

Under Afflatus Misery, Cura spells gain bonus healing based on the amount of damage most recently taken by the caster. This bonus resets when a Cura spell is cast.
*This bonus value is calculated as 60% of the damage most recently received, caps at approximately 200 damage, and grants a flat bonus to the base healing amount. 

Cura spells do not gain the Stoneskin effect from Afflatus Solace.

Cura spells gain all the expected bonuses from potency equipment/buffs and elemental affinity.

4703.title: Esuna
4703.description: Teaches the white magic Esuna. Removes one enfeebling effect you have from yourself and party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Area of effect radius is 10'.
Randomly removes one of the negative status effects which a Status Recovery -na Spell could otherwise remove from an affected target. 
With Afflatus Misery active:
*Can remove ailments removable by the spell Erase.
*Can remove up to 2 status ailments.
**Up to 3 with Cleric's Wand
**Up to 4 with Piety Wand
**Up to 5 with Asclepius

4704.title: Auspice
4704.description: Teaches the white magic Auspice. Reduces TP dealt when striking an enemy and bestows an accuracy bonus when the target is missed for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Provides the effect of Subtle Blow +10. This effect counts toward the normal Subtle Blow cap of +50.
*Orison Duckbills +1 enhance this effect to Subtle Blow +15
*Orison Duckbills +2 enhance this effect to Subtle Blow +20

Effective area radius is 10'

Under the effect of Afflatus Misery, Auspice will bestow the following additional effects.
*Light Elemental damage to each of the White Mage's initial attacks.
** This effect acts like a tier II Enspell in terms of damage calculation and activation.
* An Accuracy Bonus when target is missed. The White Mage must be under the effect Afflatus Misery to benefit from this effect.
** Auspice has been determined to add a fixed amount of accuracy for each attack that fails to connect with its target.
** Auspice's Acc. Bonus is cumulative and will not dissipate provided that the effects of Auspice and Afflatus Misery remain upon the player. (i.e., Auspice's duration must be reset by reapplying it before its effect wears off, or the accumulated bonus will be lost.)

Auspice and Enspells are mutually exclusive.
*Auspice will overwrite and be overwritten by Tier I Enspells.
*Auspice will not overwrite, but will be overwritten by, Tier II Enspells.

4706.title: Enlight
4706.description: Teaches the white magic Enlight. Adds light damage to your attacks.

fields.notes:
Damage from Enlight begins at a set point based on Divine Magic skill, then decreases by 1 damage per successful hit. The effect expires automatically when the damage reaches zero.
*The formula to determine base damage is (Divine Magic Skill/8)+12.5
*Activates on each hit in an attack round -- such as due to Double Attack, additional hits from weapons like Joyeuse, and offhanded weapons.

Also gives an accuracy bonus which mimics the damage dealt by the additional effect by a 1:1 ratio.

Enlight as a status effect may also be gained from Enchanged equipment:
*Hallowed Sword
*Sacred Lance
*Sacred Sword
*Sacred Degen
*Sacred Mace
*Sacred Maul
*Sacred Wand

4707.title: Endark
4707.description: Teaches the black magic Endark. Adds darkness damage to your attacks.

fields.notes:
Additional Effect initial damage is determined by Dark Magic Skill at the time of casting. This damage decays by 1 every successful hit until the effect wears off.
*Base damage is floor((floor(Dark Magic Skill/20) + 5) * 2.5) 
*Also gives an attack bonus which stats mimics the damage dealt by the additional effect by a 1:1 ratio, and decays by 1 per hit, in sync with the additional effect.
*Endark will automatically wear off when additional damage reaches 0 if the 3-minute duration limit is not reached first.

fields.notes:
See Red Mage: En-Spell Damage Calculations

Will affect both weapons when using Dual Wield.

Effect wears off immediately upon changing zones.

4713.title: Enwater
4713.description: Teaches the white magic Enwater. Adds water damage to your attacks.

fields.notes:
See Red Mage: En-Spell Damage Calculations

Will affect both weapons when using Dual Wield.

Effect wears off immediately upon changing zones.

4714.title: Phalanx
4714.description: Teaches the white magic Phalanx. Gives you a certain amount of damage resistance.

fields.notes:
The amount of damage resistance is calculated against every hit taken and is a function of the caster's Enhancing Magic skill at time of cast.



Floor

This damage reduction caps at 35 (500 Enhancing Magic skill).

Can be over-written by equal or greater effect strength. Lesser strength will have no effect on target. No other effect will overwrite or block Phalanx.

Stacks with other Defense and Damage Reduction buffs (or debuffs).

Can be dispelled or removed manually.

Automatons will only cast this spell when equipped with the Stormwaker Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4715.title: Reprisal
4715.description: Teaches the white magic Reprisal. Increases chance of blocking with shield, and reflects portion of blocked damage back to attacker.

fields.notes:
Increases Shield Skill by +15%. . This value constantly updated as your skill from equipment changes, not at spell cast. 

Total damage reflected is 200% of maximum HP before the spell wears off. The damage is considered Light-elemental magic damage.
*As of the May 10, 2021 update, there is no longer a damage reflection cap.

Calculated before Phalanx, Stoneskin, Sentinel and Invincible (reflects damage proportionate to the amount you would have taken without them.)

Does not overwrite spike spells. Overwritten by spike spells.

Bigger shields reflect more damage. Damage reflected appears to be 1/3 of the amount by which damage was reduced; further testing is still needed to corroborate. Does not reflect damage from blocking physical-type TP moves. Under the effects of Sentinel, reflected damage seems to range from 95%-300%. Noted while using Iron Ram Shield.  May require more experimentation with different shield sizes.

Possible MND mod, like other Damage Spikes spells which have an INT mod on the proc. rate of the additional effect.

4716.title: Regen
4716.description: Teaches the white magic Regen. Gradually restores target's HP

fields.notes:
Ticks for 5 HP every 3 seconds, restoring a base total of 125 HP.
*The duration of this spell is higher than Regen II and Regen III which each last for 20 ticks (60 seconds) instead.
*Duration caps when the target is at least Lv.21.
*Duration is increased by 9 seconds using Orison Mitts +1, and by 15 seconds using Orison Mitts +2.

A Red Mage under the effect of Composure will gain 375 HP from their own Regen spell over the course of 75 ticks.

With Cleric's Bliaut and full merits, Regen heals at one of the highest HP to MP ratios at 275 HP to 15 MP.
*Cleric's Bliaut increases this effect by 1 HP/tick.
*Each Regen Effect merit upgrade increases this effect by 1 HP/tick with a maximum of five upgrades.

A level 99 Scholar under the effects of Light Arts increases the potency of Regen to 29 HP/tick.

Automatons will only cast this spell when equipped with Soulsoother Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4717.title: Refresh
4717.description: Teaches the white magic Refresh. Gradually restores target's MP.

fields.notes:
Ticks for 3 MP every 3 seconds for a base total of 150 MP restored.
*Composure extends this to 450 MP restored.

Does not stack with and will not overwrite Sublimation, Battery Charge nor Refresh II/III.

Does stack with Indi-Refresh, and equipment/trait/ability sources of Auto Refresh.

Accession and Perpetuance confer their benefits to this spell.

4718.title: Regen II
4718.description: Teaches the white magic Regen II. Gradually restores target's HP.

fields.notes:
Ticks for 12 HP every 3 seconds, restoring a base total of 240 HP.
*Duration caps when the target is at least Lv.44.
*Cleric's Bliaut increases the amount healed by 2HP/tick for a maximum of 280 HP.
*Cleric's Bliaut + max merits = 19HP/tick for a maximum of 380 HP.
*Merits can boost this effect further, from +1 to +5 (applies only to White Mage).

When combined with Scholar's Accession stratagem, this spell can give the effect of Regen II to the entire party

A RDM can combine Composure and Regen II to get a total of 720 HP.

A level 99 Scholar under the effects of Light Arts increases the potency of Regen II to 36 HP/tick.

Automatons will only cast this spell when equipped with Soulsoother Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4719.title: Regen III
4719.description: Teaches the white magic Regen III. Gradually restores target's HP

fields.notes:
Ticks for 20 HP every 3 seconds, restoring a base total of 400 HP.
*Duration caps when the target is at least Lv.66.
*Cleric's Bliaut increases the HP healed per tick by 3.
*Merits can boost this effect further (+1 to +5)
*Cleric's Bliaut + max merits = 28HP/tick for a maximum of 560 HP.

A level 99 Scholar under the effects of Light Arts increases the potency of Regen III to 44 HP/tick.

Automatons will only cast this spell when equipped with Soulsoother Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4720.title: Flash
4720.description: Teaches the white magic Flash. Temporarily blinds an enemy, greatly lowers its accuracy.

fields.notes:
Severely reduces accuracy compared to Blind, the effect weakens over time until it wears off.
*Normal mobs have the ability to resist Flash, although this is extremely rare.
*Duration is subject to resists and partial-resists, though can last up to 12 seconds if completely unresisted.
*Stacks with Blind.
*Does not overwrite itself. If the target is already flashed it will fail to take effect.
*Acquires a significant amount of Volatile and Cumulative Enmity.
*Automatons with a Flashbulb equipped can use a non-magic version of Flash and, therefore, can not be reflected or absorbed by shadows.
*This status effect cannot be removed by Blindna, but can be removed by Erase, Esuna or Healing Waltz.

4721.title: Repose
4721.description: Teaches the white magic Repose. Puts a target to sleep.

fields.notes:
Accuracy influenced by Divine Magic, and Magic Accuracy bonuses from equipment.
*Similar to Lullaby songs, Repose is light-based and can affect undead.
*Repose will overwrite Sleep, Horde Lullaby, Foe Lullaby, and Yawn.
*Repose will not overwrite Sleep II nor will Sleep II overwrite Repose.

4722.title: Enfire II
4722.description: Teaches the white magic Enfire II. Adds fire damage to your initial attacks and lowers the target's resistance against water.

fields.notes:
Only affects main weapon, which means an off-hand weapon, for example: Bloody Rapier, can still proc its ability, in this case Drain.

Adds elemental damage to your initial attacks. Subsequent blows by characters for whom multiple attacks are possible do not receive this effect. If the initial attack misses the target, the effect will not be able to process again until the start of the next attack round.

Each successive activation increases elemental damage strength by 1 up to a predetermined limit and reduces the enemy's resistance against the opposed element. 

Enfire II is affected normally by day and weather bonuses/penalties.

Each +15 enhancing magic skill will add 2 more damage. The Enspell II damage calculations are different from the first tier Enspells: the game will calculate your current enhancing magic skill for each strike. This means that if you take your enhancing magic gear off the damage will be reduced automatically for further strikes. 

Gives -10 magic evasion to water based spells for a short duration (a few seconds). This means that the landing rate will be increased by 5% on resistant monsters and 10% on non resistant ones (see Magic Accuracy).

Effect wears off immediately upon changing zones.

Additional elemental damage effect accumulated is retained when changing weapons, as long as the spell is active, and is applied to the new main weapon slot.

Recasting Enfire II while the spell is still active will reset the additional damage effect to the base level.

4723.description: Teaches the white magic Enblizzard II. Adds ice damage to your initial attacks and lowers the target's resistance against fire.

Only affects main weapon, which means an off-hand weapon, for example: Bloody Rapier, can still proc its ability, in this case Drain.

4726.description: Teaches the white magic Enthunder II. Adds lightning damage to your initial attacks and lowers the target's resistance against earth.

fields.notes:
Only affects main weapon; an off-hand weapon, e.g. Bloody Rapier, can still proc its ability, in this case Drain.

4728.title: Teleport-Yhoat
4728.description: Teaches the white magic Teleport-Yhoat. Transports qualified party members within area of effect to Yhoat.

fields.notes:
The spell will only function on characters possessing the Yhoator Gate Crystal and have the Rise of the Zilart expansion pack installed. The key item can be obtained by traveling to F-9 in Yhoator Jungle and examining the Telepoint located in the clearing there.
*If the caster does not meet the requirements, they are still able to teleport any of their nearby qualified party members, but the caster will be left where they are.
*If the caster has the key item but does not wish to be teleported, they may avoid being teleported by casting the spell and immediately running into the next zone when the spell casts. The caster will end up in the neighboring zone but any nearby party members will still be teleported to the intended destination. It is also possible to avoid teleportation by having a Nomad Moogle change your job immediately after the spell is cast.

4729.title: Teleport-Altep
4729.description: Teaches the white magic Teleport-Altep. Transports qualified party members within area of effect to Altep.

fields.notes:
The spell will only function on characters who possess the Altepa Gate Crystal and have the Rise of the Zilart expansion pack both installed and registered. The key item can be obtained by traveling to G-7 in Eastern Altepa Desert and examining the Telepoint located in the trench there.
*If the caster does not meet the requirements, they are still able to teleport any of their nearby qualified party members, but the caster will be left where they are.
*If the caster has the key item but does not wish to be teleported, they may avoid being teleported by casting the spell and immediately running into the next zone after the spell casting reaches 75%. The caster will end up in the neighboring zone but any nearby party members will still be teleported to the intended destination. It is also possible to avoid teleportation by having a Nomad Moogle change your job immediately after the spell is cast. NOTE: This is most likely an abuse of game mechanics. I recommend buying a Scroll of Instant Warp.

4730.title: Teleport-Holla
4730.description: Teaches the white magic Teleport-Holla. Transports qualified party members within area of effect to Holla.

fields.notes:
The spell will only function on characters possessing the Holla Gate Crystal. It can be obtained by traveling to the Crag of Holla (K-8) in La Theine Plateau and examining the intact Telepoint on the northern side.
*If the caster does not meet the requirements, they are still able to teleport any of their nearby qualified party members, but the caster will be left where they are.

4733.title: Protectra
4733.description: Teaches the white magic Protectra. Enhances defense for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Effective area radius is 10'.

Protectra provides a flat +20 Defense to affected targets.

Protectra's duration is reduced on targets below level 7.

4734.title: Protectra II
4734.description: Teaches the white magic Protectra II. Enhances defense for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Effective area radius is 10'.

Protectra provides a flat +50 Defense to affected targets.

Protectra's duration is reduced on targets below level 27.

4735.title: Protectra III
4735.description: Teaches the white magic Protectra III. Enhances defense for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:

Protectra provides a flat +90 Defense to affected targets.

Protectra's duration is reduced on targets below level 47.

4738.title: Shellra
4738.description: Teaches the white magic Shellra. Enhances magical defense for party members within range.

fields.notes:
Effective area radius is 10'.

Shellra provides 25/256 magic damage reduction (≈ -9.8%). 

Shellra's duration is reduced on targets below level 17.

4739.title: Shellra II
4739.description: Teaches the white magic Shellra II. Enhances magical defense for party members within range.

Shellra II's duration is reduced on targets below level 37.

Shellra III's duration is reduced on targets below level 57.

4741.title: Shellra IV

fields.notes:

Shellra IV provides 60/256 magic damage reduction (≈ -23.4%). 

Shellra IV's duration is reduced on targets below level 68.

4742.title: Shellra V

fields.notes:

Shellra V provides 75/256 magic damage reduction (≈ -29.3%). 

Shellra V's duration is reduced on targets below level 75.

4743.title: Reraise
4743.description: Teaches the white magic Reraise Grants you the effect of Raise when you are K.O.'d.

fields.notes:
Players with Reraise are brought back from KO status with 10% HP (capped by Weakness).

25% of lost experience points are recovered.

Scholars must be under the effects of Addendum: White to cast this spell.

Consumables that grant this effect: Reraiser, Instant Reraise, Scapegoat

Charged equipment that grants this effect: Reraise Earring, Raising Earrings, Reraise Ring, Charm Wand +1, White Rarab Cap +1

Other sources of Reraise: Fields of Valor
fields.see also: Reraise II, Reraise III, Reraise IV

4744.title: Invisible
4744.description: Teaches the white magic Invisible. Lessens chance of being detected by sight.

fields.notes:
Aggressive enemies that detect by sight and nothing else will not attack Invisible players who have not taken any hostile actions against those enemies.

Invisible's base duration varies randomly between 8 and 10 minutes. This duration is shortened on characters below level 25. Composure, Perpetuance, Skulker's Cape and other equipment which increases Enhancing Magic Duration will apply their bonuses to Invisible.

Like Sneak and Deodorize, Invisible wears if attacked by an enemy in combat. Receiving an Area of Effect damage attack will not remove Invisible as long as you were not directly the target of that attack.

The following actions will not remove Invisible:
*Trick Attack.
*Using fireworks.
*Crystal synthesis.
*The Pet Commands Fight and Deploy. Summoner's Assault will remove Invisible.
*Charged item use like Trizek Ring and Facility Ring.

Invisible will not overwrite an existing Invisible effect, but when cast on one's self the old effect is removed before the new one is applied.

Invisible players may not interact with NPCs, doors or other interactable game objects like the Auction House.

Accession confers its benefits on this spell.

Invisible players are still attacked by aggressive monsters who detect by sound, magic, Job Ability use, low HP, or True Sight.

4745.title: Sneak
4745.description: Teaches the white magic Sneak. Lessens chance of being detected by sound.

fields.notes:
Aggressive enemies that detect by sound and nothing else will not attack players with Sneak who have not taken any hostile actions against those enemies.

Sneak's base duration varies randomly between 8 and 10 minutes. This duration is shortened on characters below level 20. Composure, Perpetuance, Skulker's Cape and other equipment which increases Enhancing Magic Duration will apply their bonuses to Sneak.

Like Invisible and Deodorize, Sneak wears if attacked by an enemy in combat. Receiving an Area of Effect damage attack will not remove Sneak as long as you were not directly the target of that attack.

Sneak does not wear off if characters use job abilities and cast spells that might otherwise remove Invisible.

Sneak will not overwrite an existing Sneak effect, unlike Invisible. This means you must be in a "safe" spot to recast.

Opening a Treasure Chest or Coffer removes Sneak.

Accession confers its benefits on this spell.

Players with sneak are still attacked by aggressive monsters who detect by sight, magic, Job Ability use, low HP, or True Hearing.

4746.title: Deodorize
4746.description: Teaches the white magic Deodorize. Lessens chance of being detected by smell.

fields.notes:
Enemies do not detect by smell, but sometimes they do track by smell. If a character is being chased by such enemies they can run through water (land features or weather) or have Deodorize cast on them while out of detection range, and this will cause the pursuit to end at this point.

Like Sneak and Invisible, Deodorize wears if attacked by an enemy in combat.

Deodorize's base duration varies randomly between 8 and 10 minutes. This duration is shortened on characters below level 15.

Deodorize will not overwrite an existing Deodorize effect.

Accession confers its benefits on this spell.

4747.title: Teleport-Vahzl
4747.description: Teaches the white magic Teleport-Vahzl. Transports qualified party members within area of effect to Vahzl.

fields.notes:
The spell will only function on characters possessing the Vahzl Gate Crystal. The key item can be obtained by traveling to H-8 in Xarcabard and examining the Telepoint located on the platform there.
*If the caster does not meet the requirements, they are still able to teleport any of their nearby qualified party members, but the caster will be left behind.
*If the caster has the key item but does not wish to be teleported, they may avoid being teleported by casting the spell and immediately running into the next zone when the spell cast bar reaches 75%. The caster will end up in the neighboring zone, but any nearby party members will still be teleported to the intended destination. It is also possible to avoid teleportation by having a Nomad Moogle change your job immediately after the spell is cast.

4748.title: Raise III
4748.description: Teaches the white magic Raise III Revives target from KO.

fields.notes:
Targets of Raise III are brought back from KO status with 50% HP (capped by Weakness).

90% of lost experience points are recovered.

Scholars must be under the effects of Addendum: White to cast this spell.

Pixies in Shadowreign Era zones may cast this on knocked-out players. In this case, 100% of lost experience points are recovered and players get up with 100% health (capped by Weakness).

The White Mage Trust Ferreous Coffin will cast this spell if in combat with a K.O.'d party member.

4749.title: Reraise II
4749.description: Teaches the white magic Reraise II Grants you the effect of Raise when you are K.O.'d.

fields.notes:
Players with Reraise II are brought back from KO status with 25% HP (capped by Weakness).

50% of lost experience points are recovered.

Scholars must be under the effects of Addendum: White to cast this spell.

Consumables that grant this effect: Hi-Reraiser, Revive Feather

Charged equipment that grants this effect: Reraise Gorget, Reraise Hairpin, Kocco's Earring

Other sources of Reraise II: Reraise II (Blood Pact)

4750.title: Reraise III
4750.description: Teaches the white magic Reraise III Grants you the effect of Raise when you are K.O.'d.

fields.notes:
Players with Reraise III are brought back from KO status with 50% HP (capped by Weakness).

90% of lost experience points are recovered.

Scholars must be under the effects of Addendum: White to cast this spell.

Consumables that grant this effect: Super Reraiser, Rebirth Feather, Dusty Reraise,

Other sources of Reraise III: Altana's Favor

4751.title: Erase
4751.description: Teaches the white magic Erase. Removes one detrimental magic effect from target party member.

fields.notes:
Erase will randomly remove one enfeebling effect not already covered by a -na spell.
* Negative status effects Erase will remove include Bind, Bio, Burn, Choke, Dia, Flash, Frost, Gravity, Rasp, Slow, Stun, Weight, and most Stat Down effects.

Other than the effects covered by -na spells, only a few statuses cannot be removed by Erase. Two of the more prevalent examples are Amnesia and Terror.

Unlike -na spells, Erase can only be cast on party members.

Works with both Divine Veil and Accession.

Scholar are only able to use this spell under the effects of Addendum: White or Enlightenment.

Automatons will only cast this when equipped with the Soulsoother Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

From the May 10, 2018 update: "Even if it is possible to do so, alter egos will no longer use the white magic spell Erase to remedy sphere effects generated by enemies."

4752.title: Fire
4752.description: Teaches the black magic Fire Deals fire damage to an enemy.

fields.notes: Puppetmaster Automatons only cast this spell when equipped with a Stormwaker Head or Spiritreaver Head.

4824.title: Gravity
4824.description: Teaches the black magic Gravity. Weighs an enemy down and lowers its movement speed.

fields.notes:
The movement speed reduction is 26% 

The Accuracy of this spell is affected by the caster's Enfeebling Magic skill and INT.

The duration of this spell's effect is set at random. Partial resists will cut this duration in half, but not affect the movement speed penalty. Certain Notorious Monsters build a gradual resistance to this spell over time.

*As of the July 2014 udate, targets under the effects of Weight no longer have their physical evasion decreased (by 10).

4828.title: Poison
4828.description: Teaches the black magic Poison. Poisons an enemy and gradually reduces its HP.

fields.notes:
Damage over time is a function of the caster's Enfeebling Magic skill. Ticks for a minimum of 1 damage every 3 seconds. Damage scales according to the following formula:

Damage/tick = (Enfeebling Magic skill - 225) / 5 

Enfeebling Magic's contribution to Poison damage caps at 500 skill.

Partial resists of Poison halve its duration.

Automatons will cast this spell under every Head configuration except Valoredge Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4829.title: Poison II
4829.description: Teaches the black magic Poison II. Poisons an enemy and gradually reduces its HP.

fields.notes:
Damage over time is a function of the caster's Enfeebling Magic skill. Ticks for a minimum of 4 damage every 3 seconds. Damage scales according to the following formulae:

400~500 Enfeebling Magic skill: 
Damage/tick = 82 - Floor[(129/430)(500-Skill)] 

500+ Enfeebling Magic skill: 
82 + Floor[(180/783)(Skill-500)]

There is no known cap to the damage.

Partial resists of Poison halve its duration.

Automatons will cast this spell under every Head configuration except Valoredge Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4833.title: Poisonga
4833.description: Teaches the black magic Poisonga. Poisons enemies within area of effect and gradually reduces their HP.

fields.notes:
Effective area radius is 10'.

Damage over time is a function of the caster's Enfeebling Magic skill. Ticks for a minimum of 1 damage every 3 seconds. Poisonga's damage over time was not officially announced as having increased as part of the March 2015 update. . No testing data exists to see if its damage over time component was raised to match Poison's new damage formula. Prior to the update, Poisonga's damage ticked for a minimum of 1 damage per tick and a maximum of 3 damage per tick.

Partial resists of Poison halve its duration.

The damage over time varies with the caster's Dark Magic Skill 
*0~40 skill: 1 HP/3 seconds
*41~80 skill: 2 HP/3 seconds
*81~ skill: 3 HP/3 seconds

Bio overwrites the equivalent tier of Dia spells, and is overwritten by higher-tier Dia spells.

Automatons will not cast this spell if equipped with a Valoredge Head.
