4843.title: Burn
4843.description: Teaches the black magic Burn Deals fire damage that lowers an enemy's intelligence and gradually reduces its HP.

fields.notes:
The damage over time and amount by which target intelligence is lowered is determined entirely by the INT of the caster and is not subject to the difference in INT between caster and target. 
*~39 INT: Target stat -5, 1 HP/3 seconds
*40~69 INT: Target stat -7, 2 HP/3 seconds
*70~99 INT: Target stat -9, 3 HP/3 seconds
*100~149 INT: Target stat -11, 4 HP/3 seconds
*150~ INT: Target stat -13, 5 HP/3 seconds
The Group 2 Elemental Magic Debuff Duration Merit Point Category will extend the duration of this spell by 12 seconds per merit level, to a maximum of 60 seconds.

The Group 2 Elemental Magic Debuff Potency Merit Point Category lowers the targets stat by an additional 2 and increase the damage over time by an additional 1 HP/3 seconds per merit level.

Elemental Debuffs interact with each other using the same rules of the Elemental wheel. Burn overwrites Frost and is overwritten by Drown.
*Burn, Choke, and Shock may all be present on the same target.
*Drown, Frost, and Rasp may all be present on the same target.

See the Elemental Debuff page for further details.

4849.title: Addle
4849.description: Teaches the white magic Addle Decreases an enemy's magic accuracy and increases its spellcasting time.

fields.notes:
The base effect of Addle is to increase casting time by 20% and decrease magic accuracy by 20.

This effect is modified by the difference in MND between the caster and the target. Every 5 MND the caster has over the target increases casting time by an additional 1% and decreases magic accuracy by an additional 1, and caps at 100 total MND difference. This puts the maximum effect at 40% increased casting time and -40 Magic Accuracy.

Regardless of potency, Addle is overwritten by and will not overwrite Pining Nocturne.

Automatons may cast this spell with any equipped head except Valoredge Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4850.title: Refresh II
4850.description: Teaches the white magic Refresh II. Gradually restores target's HP

fields.notes:
Ticks for 6 MP every 3 seconds for a base total of 300 MP restored.
*Composure extends this to restore 900 MP restored.

Does not stack with and will not overwite Sublimation.

Does not stack and overwrites Battery Charge and Refresh

Does stack with Indi-Refresh, and equipment/trait/ability sources of Auto Refresh.

Accession does not confer its benefits to this spell

4853.title: Drain
4853.description: Teaches the black magic Drain Steals an enemy's HP. Ineffective against undead.

fields.notes:
Base potency of the spell depends exclusively on Dark Magic Skill. It can drain more than the caster's current missing HP, and can drain for more than the target's remaining HP.
*Drained amount falls within a range below a maximum amount and above 1/2 of that maximum amount, before equipment, weather and magic burst bonuses/multipliers.
**0~300 skill: m potency is floor(skill/3 + 20) 
**300+ skill: base potency is approximately floor(skill * 0.9) 
Automatons will only cast this spell if equipped with a Spiritreaver Head.

4854.title: Drain II
4854.description: Teaches the black magic Drain II. Steals an enemy's HP, potentially increasing maximum HP. Ineffective against undead.

fields.notes:
Base potency of the spell depends exclusively on Dark Magic Skill. It can drain more than the caster's current missing HP, and can drain for more than the target's remaining HP. Grants a temporary Max HP Boost status based on the drained HP amount in excess of the caster's current maximum HP.
*Drained amount falls within a range below a maximum amount and above 1/2 of that maximum amount, before equipment, weather and magic burst bonuses/multipliers.
**0~300 skill: m potency is floor(skill/3 + 20) 
**300+ skill: base potency is approximately floor(skill * 1.35) 
*The Max HP Boost bonus is overwritten by the effects of Giant's Drink.
**The status effect duration is affected by the augment on Dark Knight Relic equipment.

4857.title: Blaze Spikes
4857.description: Teaches the black magic Blaze Spikes. Covers you with magical fire spikes. Enemies that hit you take fire damage.

fields.notes:
See Calculating Spikes Damage for the particulars on how this spell deals damage.

A monster that receives spikes damage from another player who would not receive experience points causes the monster to yield no experience points, even if the person is not in the party of the members who defeat it. 

Manifestation makes this spell AOE to party members.

Gothic Gauntlets, Gothic Sabatons, Cocytus Pole and Ice Gauntlets all grant this effect.

Manifestation makes this spell AOE to party members.

4860.description: Teaches the black magic Stun. Temporarily prevents an enemy from acting.

fields.notes:
Will not take effect if the target is petrified; the reverse is also true.

The Stun effect itself is extremely accurate, even at low levels of Dark Magic Skill. Targets that are highly magic evasive or have Lightning elemental resistance may resist this spell's effects.

Several NMs build gradual resistance to the effects of Stun, lowering the duration of the spell over time and eventually becoming immune to it.

4861.title: Sleep
4861.description: Teaches the black magic Sleep. Puts an enemy to sleep.

fields.notes:
Break, Bind and Sleep can all be active on the same target.

Partial resists of this spell reduce its duration.

Scholars may only cast this spell under the effects of Addendum: Black

4862.title: Blind
4862.description: Teaches the black magic Blind. Blinds an enemy, lowers its accuracy.

fields.notes:
The Accuracy Down potency of Blind uses the following derived formula:

Accuracy Down value = (Caster INT - Target MND) x 0.225 + 23 

The minimum Accuracy Down value is 5, the maximum is 50. 

A partial resist results in half-duration for the effect.

Automatons will cast this spell with every Head configuration except Valoredge Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

4866.title: Bind
4866.description: Teaches the black magic Bind Binds an enemy in place, immobilizing it.

fields.notes:
The duration of the effect is set randomly and cannot be affected by Enfeebling Magic skill, Magic Accuracy, or INT. 

A partial resist results in half-duration for the effect.

Bind may be removed early if the target is dealt damage by physical attacks, magic, weapon skills or job abilities.

Bind is not removed from players who change areas. It must wear off normally.

4867.title: Sleep II
4867.description: Teaches the black magic Sleep II. Puts an enemy to sleep.

fields.notes:
This spell's accuracy is a function of the caster's Magic Accuracy and INT.

Partial resists of this spell reduce its duration.

Break, Bind and Sleep can all be active on the same target.

Sleep II overwrites Sleep, Sleepga, Foe Lullaby I/II and Horde Lullaby I/II.

Scholars may only cast this spell under the effects of Addendum: Black

4869.title: Warp
4869.description: Teaches the black magic Warp. Transports you to your home point.

4870.title: Warp II
4870.description: Teaches the black magic Warp II. Transports target party member to their home point.

4871.title: Escape
4871.description: Teaches the black magic Escape. Transports party members within area of effect out of a dungeon.

fields.notes:
"Dungeon" describes any cave (e.g. Crawlers' Nest), underground complex (e.g. Eldieme Necropolis, Horutoto Ruins), enemy stronghold like Davoi and Fei'Yin, or Battlefield like Cloister of Tides. Escape may not be cast outside of these types of areas.


Escape teleports all party members within range to a fixed location outside of the current Dungeon. See this page for a comprehensive list of Escape points, or this guide for historic information on how Escape was used as a shortcut before Mounts, Home Points and Unity Concord warp took over.

4872.title: Tractor
4872.description: Teaches the black magic Tractor. Drags a K.O.'d target toward you.

fields.notes:
Transports K.O.'d players without having to revive them.
*When cast, the K.O.'d player gains the option to be moved to the caster's location (which they may accept or decline, similar to Raise status).
*Due to Tractor's short spellcasting range, multiple casts of Tractor are required to move a character over long distances.
*Tractor does not work in some instanced BCNMs, such as Assault areas, Salvage battlefields, or The Ashu Talif.
The spell is primarily used to move K.O.'d players out of dangerous areas so they can be Raised. Also, to transport players to areas that are otherwise too difficult or time-consuming for them to reach on foot (alive).
*A couple of well-known examples of the latter are reaching the northern entrance to The Eldieme Necropolis in Batallia Downs (normally only accessible by using the Sparkling Light at (F-5) or traversing through Beaucedine Glacier), or reaching the area in Yuhtunga Jungle where the Fire Fragment for Headstone Pilgrimage is obtained (normally only accessible by passing through Ifrit's Cauldron).

Raise and Tractor statuses cannot coexist. Tractor has "no effect" on a player with active Raise status. They must decline the option to revive before they can be Tractored. Likewise, someone with Tractor status active must accept or decline it before they can be Raised.

Tractor counts as moving to another area (even though you end up in the same area). Certain quests or NM fights involving multiple steps require that players do not move to different areas between steps; otherwise, they have to start them over from the beginning. The target's TP is also set to 0. The only known exception to this is Reive content. 
*For instance, if your party is fighting a ???-spawned Notorious Monster for a quest and a party member is K.O.'d prior to the NM's defeat, casting Tractor on him/her after the NM is defeated may prevent the Tractored player from getting the key item from the ??? point that normally becomes available after defeating the NM. Then the player must spawn and fight the NM again to receive credit.
*Accepting Tractor during Besieged resets all Imperial Standing and Experience Points accumulated during the battle, and refreshes the Temporary Items obtained upon zoning into Al Zahbi during a beastman invasion.
*Removes Allied Tags when accepted during a Campaign Battle. All potential experience points and Allied Notes accumulated during the battle are lost when the player is Tractored. 
*In Abyssea, Tractor removes Abyssea-related effects (Atma, Cruor buffs, and Visitant Status. The player is also transported back to the entrance camp with 5 minutes until ejection.
*All progress towards Grounds of Valor training rewards and bonuses are reset. 

Tractor does not work in towns where battle is not possible. Attempting to cast it gives the message "You cannot use Tractor in this area."

4885.title: Dread Spikes
4885.description: Teaches the black magic Dread Spikes. Covers you with magical darkness spikes. Steals HP from enemies that hit you. Ineffective against undead.

fields.notes:
While Dread Spikes is in effect, the caster drains up to 100% of the damage inflicted upon them by a melee attack from an enemy monster, subject to resist rates and other forms of damage reduction.
*The total amount of spike damage dealt is capped at 50% of the caster's Maximum HP at cast time. This cap can be increased with Job Point Gifts, and by wearing Heathen's Cuirass +1. When the damage cap is reached, the spikes effects wears off even if 180 seconds have not passed. 
*Dread Spikes does not drain damage incurred from TP attacks or Physical Blue Magic cast by enemies. This includes attacks by monsters which have TP-move properties to them (e.g. Mantids, Yztarg, etc).
*The HP absorbed will not generate enmity for the Dark Knight.
*Effect is reduced to 20% during Conflict.
*The Dark Knight will still be KO'd if a single attack inflicts an amount of damage that exceeds their remaining HP.

When enemies cast Dread Spikes, the base duration in 60 seconds.

Elemental Spirits cast spells based on observable priorities:
*Casts Curaga IV or Cure V if the HP of a party member is in the orange or red. It seems to favor this over Cure V at high levels, and often casts Curaga IV on its Summoner even if the Summoner is solo.
*Not affected by its own Curaga spells.
*Can cast Curaga IV on another party in its summoner's alliance.
*Casts Holy/Holy II, Banish I - Banish IV, Flash, and Dia/Dia II when used to fight against an enemy, depending on Light Spirit's level. It can cast Cure V on a single party member whose HP is in the orange or red, even if Light Spirit is currently engaging a target.
* Cannot cure, enhance, or otherwise target itself in any way.
* Seems to have around 2170 MP at lv59. 
* Possesses a light Regen effect.

4912.title: Distract
4912.description: Teaches the black magic Distract. Reduces target's physical evasion

fields.notes:
The strength of the Evasion Down effect varies with a set minimum requirement on the caster's Enfeebling Magic skill to reach a base potency, further modulated by a difference between caster and target MND, using the following derived formula:

Evasion Down value = Base Value + int((Caster MND - Target MND) x 0.2)

4976.title: Foe Requiem
4976.description: Teaches the Foe Requiem. Deals sonic damage to enemies.

fields.notes:
Foe Requiem's damage appears tied to combined singing/instrument skill. The bonus from combined skill caps at +1. 
*The basic damage dealt every 3 seconds for Foe Requiem is 2.
*The acknowledged formula for Requiem song damage cap (before equipment) is Tier of Spell + 1.
*The debuff duration is subject to magic resist rates and can vary greatly. Testing has approximated the base, unresisted duration in seconds of Requiem spells at 48 + (Tier of Song x 16) 
*Equipment bonuses work differently for Requiem songs than most others.
**"Requiem +1" or "All Songs +1" increase the duration of the effect by 10%.
**"Requiem +2" or "All Songs +2" and above further increases the duration by 10% and the damage over time by +1 every 3 seconds. 
*Soul Voice doubles the damage over time.
*The "Requiem Effect" Job Point category for Bards can increase the base damage over time of Requiem by up to +60 every 3 seconds.

4984.title: Horde Lullaby
4984.description: Teaches the Horde Lullaby. Puts enemies within area of effect to sleep

fields.notes:

*Horde Lullaby's effective AOE is only a 4' radius circle compared to Sleepga's 10' radius.
**The use of a String Instrument doubles the radius to 8'
*Equipment that gives "Lullaby +" or "All Songs +" increases the unresisted duration of Lullaby by 10%.
**This is an inferior bonus compared to equipment which increases song duration, such as an upgraded Daurdabla.
*The Job Point Category "Lullaby Duration" for Bards can increase the base duration by up to 20 seconds.
*The Group 1 Merit Point Category "Lullaby Recast" for Bards can reduce the recast time by up to 5 seconds.
*Lullaby Spells do not overwrite each other and will have no effect on enemies already slept by Lullaby.
**Lullaby will also not overwite Sleep, Sleepga, Blue Magic that inflicts Sleep or the effects of Light Shot. 
**Lullaby is overwritten by Sleep II, Sleepga II and Repose.

4986.title: Army's Paeon
4986.description: Teaches the Army's Paeon. Gradually restores HP for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:

5069.title: Dark Threnody
5069.description: Teaches the Dark Threnody. Reduces an enemy's resistance against darkness.

fields.notes:
Threnodies reduce the target's Magic Resistance by a natural cap of 50. 
*Testing before 2014 could not be found to determine the relationship of combined Singing/Instrument skill and and the amount of Magic Resistance, but for the purposes of level 99 content it is sufficent to treat the baseline as 50.
*Threnody effects do not stack with each other.
*Equipment that gives "Threnody +" or "All Songs +" increase the potency of the resistance down and song duration by 10% per +1

5070.title: Magic Finale
5070.description: Teaches the Magic Finale. Removes one beneficial magic effect from an enemy.

fields.notes:
Dispels a buff at random from a target enemy.
*As a Light-elemental spell, this is effective at removing buffs from monster families with innately high resistance to Dark Elemental Magic that makes Dispel ineffective (e.g. Soulflayers, Vampyr).
*The Group 1 Merit Point Category for Bards Finale Recast can reduce the recast time by up to 5 seconds.
*Equipment that gives "Finale +" and "All Songs+" are assumed to increase the magic accuracy of this spell by a set percentage per +1. This is not a thoroughly-tested theory but a better one hasn't taken its place.

5071.title: Foe Lullaby
5071.description: Teaches the Foe Lullaby. Puts an enemy to sleep.

fields.notes:
As a Light-elemental sleep, Lullaby is an effective method of disabling foes where dark-based Sleep spells are ineffective.
*Equipment that gives "Lullaby +" or "All Songs +" increases the unresisted duration of Lullaby by 10%.
*The Job Point Category "Lullaby Duration" for Bards can increase the base duration by up to 20 seconds.
*The Group 1 Merit Point Category "Lullaby Recast" for Bards can reduce the recast time by up to 5 seconds.
*Lullaby Spells do not overwrite each other and will have no effect on enemies already slept by Lullaby.
**Lullaby will also not overwite Sleep, Sleepga, Blue Magic that inflicts Sleep or the effects of Light Shot. 
**Lullaby is overwritten by Sleep II, Sleepga II and Repose.

5073.title: Chocobo Mazurka
5073.description: Teaches the Chocobo Mazurka. Increases movement speed for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Chocobo Mazurka grants a flat 20% Movement Speed bonus, regardless of singing/instrument skill.
*Does not stack with Raptor Mazurka, Flee, or Quickening from any source.
*Effect is removed by attacking an enemy or being attacked by an enemy.
*Stacks with Movement Speed bonuses on equipment.
*Stacks with the effects of Bolter's Roll.
*Equipment that gives "Mazurka +" or "All Songs +" increases the duration of the song by 10% per +1 level, but do not increase the Movement Speed bonus.
*Has no effect on level 1 characters.

5075.title: Raptor Mazurka
5075.description: Teaches the Raptor Mazurka. Increases movement speed for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Raptor Mazurka grants a flat 12% Movement Speed bonus, regardless of singing/instrument skill.
*Does not stack with Chocobo Mazurka, Flee, or Quickening from any source.
*Effect is removed by attacking an enemy or being attacked by an enemy.
*Stacks with Movement Speed bonuses on equipment.
*Stacks with the effects of Bolter's Roll.
*Equipment that gives "Mazurka +" or "All Songs +" increases the duration of the song by 10% per +1 level, but do not increase the Movement Speed bonus.

5076.title: Foe Sirvente
5076.description: Teaches the Foe Sirvente. Suppresses enmity loss for party members within area of effect

fields.notes:
Foe Sirvente reduces Enmity lost as a result of taking damage or via natural decay over time by a flat 40% as of the September 2019 Version Update. 

The maximum potency of this effect is measured at 50%. 

Equipment that gives "All Songs +" increases the duration of the song by 10% per +1 level. It has no effect on the suppression of enmity loss.

5077.title: Adventurer's Dirge
5077.description: Teaches the Adventurer's Dirge. Decreases enmity for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Adventurer's Dirge grants a flat -32 Enmity as of the September 2019 Version Update. 


Equipment that gives "All Songs +" increases the duration of the song by 10% per +1 level. It has no effect on the potency of the Enmity down effect. The Enmity down bonus is counted against the total Enmity -50 cap.

5078.title: Sentinel's Scherzo
5078.description: Teaches the Sentinel's Scherzo. Mitigates the impact of severely damaging attacks for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
Scherzo acts as a barrier that activates against single physical or magical attacks that would take 75% or more of a target's HP, after accounting for Damage Taken- effects on gear. It reduces that damage by an amount influenced by the combined Singing and Instrument Skill of the Bard.
*Damage Reduction % = floor(((Singing Skill + Instrument Skill) - 350) / 10)
*Damage Reduction % from Scherzo caps at 45% before equipment bonuses.
*Equipment that gives "Scherzo +" or "All Songs +" increases the damage reduction by 1% per +1 level.
*When combined with other sources of "mitigates severe damage" effects (such as Earthen Armor), Scherzo's effect is counted against a total combined damage mitigation cap of 95%. 
*Soul Voice and Marcato only increase the duration of this song, and not its effects on reducing severe damage taken.

5079.title: Foe Lullaby II
5079.description: Teaches the Foe Lullaby II. Puts an enemy to sleep.

fields.notes:
As a Light-elemental sleep, Lullaby is an effective method of disabling foes where dark-based Sleep spells are ineffective.
*Equipment that gives "Lullaby +" or "All Songs +" increases the unresisted duration of Lullaby by 10%.
*The Job Point Category "Lullaby Duration" for Bards can increase the base duration by up to 20 seconds.
*The Group 1 Merit Point Category "Lullaby Recast" for Bards can reduce the recast time by up to 5 seconds.
*Lullaby Spells do not overwrite each other and will have no effect on enemies already slept by Lullaby.
**Lullaby will also not overwite Sleep, Sleepga, Blue Magic that inflicts Sleep or the effects of Light Shot. 
**Lullaby is overwritten by Sleep II, Sleepga II and Repose.

5082.title: Cura II
5082.description: Teaches the white magic Cura II Restores HP for party members within area of effect.

fields.notes:
10' effective area radius.

The base heal value is 90.

Under Afflatus Misery, Cura spells gain bonus healing based on the amount of damage most recently taken by the caster. This bonus resets when a Cura spell is cast.
*This bonus value is calculated as % of the damage most recently received, caps at approximately 200 damage, and grants a flat bonus to the base healing amount. 

Cura spells do not gain the Stoneskin effect from Afflatus Solace.

Cura spells gain all the expected bonuses from potency equipment/buffs and elemental affinity.

5085.title: Regen IV
5085.description: Teaches the white magic Regen IV. Gradually restores target's HP

fields.notes:
Ticks for 30 HP every 3 seconds, restoring a base total of 600 HP.
*Duration caps when the target is at least Lv.86.
*Cleric's Bliaut increases the HP healed per tick by 4.
*Merits can boost this effect further (+1 to +5)
*Stacks with the SCH Stratagem Accession.
*Orison Mitts +1/Orison Mitts +2 Increases duration of the Regen family by 10/15 seconds.
*Cleric's Bliaut + Orison Mitts +2 + max merits = 39HP/tick for a maximum of 975 HP over 75 seconds.

A level 99 Scholar under the effects of Light Arts increases the potency of Regen IV to 54 HP/tick.
*Savant's Bonnet +2 increases the HP healed per tick by 4, making the maximum HP per tick as 58. 

Automatons will only cast this spell when equipped with Soulsoother Head, maneuvers and attachments permitting.

6569.title: Slow II
6569.description: Teaches the white magic Slow II. Reduces an enemy's attack speed.

fields.notes:
The potency of the attack speed reduction is a function of the difference between caster and target MND.

The lowest potency (at ΔMND ‎≤ -75) is 16.5%, the maximum potency (at ΔMND ≥ 75) is 39.1% 

Slow II overwrites Slow, Hojo: Ni, and Slowga (Blood Pact)


Partial resists of this spell halve the duration.

6570.title: Paralyze II
6570.description: Teaches the white magic Paralyze II. Paralyzes an enemy.

fields.notes:
The potency of the paralysis is a function of the difference between caster and target MND.

The lowest activation rate of Paralyze is 14%, at ΔMND = -40. The highest activation rate of Paralyze is 34%, at ΔMND = 40. 

Partial resists of this spell halve the duration.

Characters who learned this spell via Group II Red Mage merits prior to the August 2019 update kept this spell and did not need to relearn it.

6571.title: Phalanx II
6571.description: Teaches the white magic Phalanx II. Gives you a certain amount of damage resistance.

fields.notes:
The amount of damage resistance is calculated against every hit taken and is a function of the caster's Enhancing Magic skill at time of cast.

At or below 300 Enhancing Magic Skill:



300 Enhancing Magic Skill or above:



This damage reduction caps at 35 (500 Enhancing Magic skill).

Can be over-written by equal or greater effect strength. Lesser strength will have no effect on target. No other effect will overwrite or block Phalanx.

Stacks with other Defense and Damage Reduction buffs (or debuffs).

Can be dispelled or removed manually.

*Affects all magical effects including Cures and Elemental weapon skills.
*Does NOT affect the associated elemental penalties for the current weather/day.

18149.notes:
Additional effect: Sleep
 * Sleep duration may be resisted. Ranged accuracy seems to affect resist rate.
 * Sleep lasts ~8-22 seconds.
 * On monsters of significantly higher level than yourself, including Notorious Monsters, the Additional Efffect Sleep can wear off almost instantly.

 * The effect can trigger on Weapon Skill.

18151.title: Bloody Bolt
18151.notes:
Additional effect: HP drain
 * This effect works similarly to the black magic spell Drain, inflicting damage to the enemy and returning HP to the player.
 * Damage is inflicted to the enemy regardless of the player's current HP, but only the amount of HP returned to the player is reported.
 * The amount of damage is affected by both the player's and monster's Intelligence, the monster's damage bonus or penalty for piercing damage, and the monster's resistance or weakness to dark elemental magic.
 * Aside from the damage reduction, monsters resistant to dark elemental magic will tend to resist the effect entirely.
 * Monsters that cannot be Drained, such as Undead, are immune to this effect.
 * This effect can trigger on Weapon Skills.

19319.title: MMM Fishing Rod
19319.description: A technologically advanced fishing rod born from the genius minds of the Moblin Maze Mongers.

fields.notes: This rod is able to catch both large and small fish. Ideal if you do not have a suitable rod of your own for the maze. However, outside the maze, it has a terrible stamina depletion rate for any fishing whatsoever.

19320.title: Lu Shang's Fishing Rod +1
19320.description: A legendary fishing rod believed to have caught a sea dragon.

fields.image caption: Lu Shang's Fishing Rod +1
fields.notes:
Fishing Tackle
*This rod is able to catch both big and small fish efficiently.
*No fish will ever be "too small" to catch with this rod, but it can still be occasionally broken by the biggest fishes.
*"Biggest fishes" seems to refer to any fish that can be more than 1500 or 2000 PZ in weight. Length seems to have no effect.
*This rod gives an additional 10 seconds of reel endurance over a regular Lu Shang's Fishing Rod.

fields.notes:
